page.marginRule: Equal on all four edges. Band 0.65–0.8in. Personal tone — same geometry discipline as cover letters, warmer chrome.

contentBox.rule: At 0.75in margins the printable area is 9.5in tall. Print `.page` uses min-height: 9.5in (NOT fixed height).

pageModel.date: .letter-date { text-align: right; flex: 0 0 auto; white-space: nowrap; }
pageModel.signoff: .signoff { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 28px; flex: 0 0 auto; text-align: left; break-inside: avoid; }
pageModel.footer: .letter-foot { margin-top: 1.25rem; padding-top: 0.75rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--dim); }
pageModel.printPage: .page { width: auto; height: auto; min-height: 9.5in; margin: 0; padding: 0; /* NO overflow:hidden */ }
pageModel.rule: Personal letterhead: identity block top-LEFT (name + optional soft rule), DATE pinned top-RIGHT. Greeting + body in .letter-main. Closing + Parisienne script name bottom-LEFT. Soft footer rule under the sign-off. Same CZI-safe print model as cover letters — never fixed height + overflow:hidden.
⛔forbidden: Résumé bottom-RIGHT signature on a personal letter
Cover-letter job hooks / employer-specific framing — this is family/friends

left: display name (Parisienne or brand script optional for first name)
header.inspiredBy: Résumé header rhythm (identity left / meta right) without ATS chrome or skill rows.

order: optional full legal name in smaller roman under the script

fonts.scriptName: Parisienne — first-name mark only (same role as résumé/cover script)
fonts.body: Readable serif or system — personal letters may use a gentle serif; ATS rules do not apply

signature.not: Cover-letter Warm regards + title + EMAIL tracking — keep this human, not application

fitToOnePage.rule: Prefer one page. When it runs long: cut prose first, then tighten line-height, then widen margin to 0.8in. Never clip.

guards: check_pagefit — exactly 1 page preferred; no ink clipped
verifyByEye: Date sits top-RIGHT. Script name sits bottom-LEFT with air above it. Soft footer does not collide with the closing.
bestFor: Family / friend letters (not professional cover letters). Cover letters → layouts/cover-letter/one-page-letter.json. Résumés → layouts/resume/two-page-standard.json.
